## Last-checked: 2026-09-21

# rpx

> RPX Pro — RolePlay Xtreme Professional Edition

Canonical repository: https://github.com/entertain-and-more/rpx

A professional, offline-capable, open-source control center for tabletop pen & paper RPG sessions.
Built with Python + PySide6 (Qt6). Features a multi-map world system, soundboard, light effects, combat engine,
AI prompt generator across 7 specialized roles, JSON-RPC CLI/API for autonomous agents, and a static PWA companion for campaign bundle viewing.

Use this repository when looking for local-first game-master tooling, a PySide6 tabletop RPG
session manager, or an LLM-controllable campaign backend that operates strictly offline with zero network egress.

## Tools & Verification

- `python RPX_Pro_1.py` — launch the desktop application (or `START.bat` on Windows)
- `python -m rpx_pro.app --cli` — start in JSON-RPC CLI mode for LLM / autonomous agent control via stdin/stdout
- `pytest` — run Python unit & contract test suite (48 passed, 1 skipped | 100% green)
- `node --test web_companion/tests/*.mjs` — run web companion PWA test suite (17 passed)
- `python _scripts/verify_release_metadata.py` — verify strict release and privacy metadata contract
- `cd web_companion && python -m http.server 8765` — serve the PWA companion locally

## Install

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
python RPX_Pro_1.py
```

Requires Python 3.10+, PySide6 (Qt6). `pygame` is optional (audio fallback).

## Target Personas

- `[PERSONA-01]` Tabletop RPG Game Masters (GMs / DMs) needing an all-in-one local control desk with second-monitor player screen
- `[PERSONA-02]` Privacy-Conscious Players & Homebrew Lore Creators demanding 100% offline local storage (`rpx_pro_data/`)
- `[PERSONA-03]` Autonomous AI Agent Developers & LLM Tool Builders requiring a headless JSON-RPC CLI backend over stdin/stdout
- `[PERSONA-04]` Mobile Session Companions & Tablet Users inspecting character status via static offline PWA bundles

## Governance & Runtime Invariants

- `INV-LOCAL-01`: 100% Offline & Local-First Zero-Egress (`rpx_pro_data/`)
- `INV-USER-02`: Unprivileged User-Mode & Non-Elevation (`RunAsInvoker`)
- `INV-DUAL-03`: Dual-Screen State Isolation & Player Screen Mirroring
- `INV-RPC-04`: Headless JSON-RPC CLI Interface (`rpx_pro.cli`)
- `INV-BUNDLE-05`: Deterministic Campaign Bundle Export (`rpx-campaign-bundle-v1`)
- `INV-PWA-06`: Zero-Cloud Client-Side PWA Companion (`web_companion/`)
- `INV-COPYLEFT-07`: Permissive Licensing (MIT) & PySide6 Dynamic Linking (LGPLv3 §4)
- `INV-LLM-08`: Privacy-Guarded AI Prompt Generation across 7 specialized roles
- `INV-ECO-09`: Modular Sibling Ecosystem Interoperability (`entertain-and-more`, `open-bricks`)
- `INV-SLA-10`: Contractual Security SLA (48h / 5d triage) & Multi-Platform CI (Win/macOS/Linux)
